Fresh one-day Developer Edition scratch org; six running-user LocaleSidKey values, LanguageLocaleKey en_US. Seed and query are in seed.apex and query.apex. The running user's locale was updated in a separate transaction before each pair of anonymous executions, using API 62.0 and 67.0. The query orders BillingCity ascending with nulls first and AccountNumber ascending as a tie breaker. The org was deleted and a subsequent org display returned not found.
